summary: Erayak Power Solution Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for July 9, 2026. The meeting seeks shareholder approval of a share capital reduction and reorganization, including reducing par value from US$0.22 to US$0.00001 per share, subdividing unissued shares, canceling excess authorized shares, and confirming new authorized capital of US$10,000. These are routine corporate actions to adjust par value and authorized share structure. There is no transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, going-private, or other special situation. This filing does not constitute a special situation event.
